title: You Cast Level 2 Ban, Again
description: You Cast Level 2 Ban, Again — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Yakov Smearnov

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Slay the Banned Farmers in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag again and then return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Yakov Smearnov

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Slay the Banned Farmers in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag again and then return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

You know, if these Banned Farmers would just share these golded vegetables we wouldn't have to ban the whole lot of them.... Oh well, thank goodness banning is such a blast!

Slay these Banned Farmers located on Level 1, the branch off of Level 1, Level 2, Level 3, the branch off of Level 3, Level 4, and the branch off of Level 4. Do this task and return to me, Yakov Smearnov, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell when it is so.

Turn-in:

You sure are a natural. You sure you've never banned someone before? Let me know when you want to do this quest again.

Objectives:

  • Slay the Banned Farmer on Level 1
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on the Level 1 Branch
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on Level 2
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on Level 3
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on the Level 3 Branch
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on Level 4
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on the Level 4 Branch

Level range: 82–85
